comparison.objective: Remove a hot-pot lid by opening it away from the operator and set it down; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Direction-sensitive lid tipping and carrying versus coaxial small-tool control, regulated impact, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Far side opens first, lid clears and is placed on the counter; candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures with no damage or escaped tang.
comparison.reason: The record tests safe removal trajectory, not fracture mechanics or retained-component protection.
